questions.question: How should /rvw-pr post when no GitHub MCP posting tool is loaded (this machine)?

options.label: gh REST fallback, MCP first (Recommended)
options.description: MCP's pending-review flow stays first, so claude.ai/code and MCP sessions are unchanged. With no MCP posting tool, the reviewer posts one `gh api POST .../reviews` with nested `-F 'comments[][path]=…'` fields. No JSON file is needed, so it stays read-only. Same posted-count check. If the call is refused or fails, it returns 'not posted' as today. Replaces SKILL.md:145's 'not gh' rule.

options.label: Caller posts via gh
options.description: The reviewer stays non-posting. Codify what I did by hand: the main session writes ./tmp/review-N.json and runs `gh api --input`. Fewer changes to the reviewer, but every local /rvw-pr needs a second step in the main session.

options.label: Connect GitHub MCP locally
options.description: No skill change: set up the MCP_DOCKER GitHub server on this machine so the existing path works. A config change outside the repo. Posting still breaks on any machine without it.

questions.question: Which surfaces should the change cover?

options.label: rvw-pr + ship's panel post (Recommended)
options.description: rvw-pr SKILL.md Step 4, posting.md (gh variant; the 'single call drops comments' warning scoped to MCP), the CLAUDE-REFERENCE I/O-split write row, and ship/SKILL.md's orchestrator post, which uses posting.md. /fix-pr's replies stay as they are.

options.label: Also /fix-pr writes
options.description: Also give /fix-pr's replies and thread resolution a gh REST fallback. A larger change; resolving threads needs GraphQL, which cloud gh lacks, so that part stays MCP-only there.

questions.question: Posting via gh is verified on #1174. What next for its 3 review findings?

options.label: Run /fix-pr 1174 now (Recommended)
options.description: Fix all three on the branch and reply to each thread. For the partial post: a failed FILE call names its own finding, so return those; a count shortfall after every call succeeded can't say which comment is missing, so return the full set marked 'compare with the PR before posting'. Narrow the git claim to what was measured. Correct the budget reasons. Runs outside the worktree, editing it by path.

options.label: Leave them for later
options.description: Stop here. The PR keeps 3 open threads; the posting path itself works.
